baselineScope.method: SHA-256 of named source files plus the expanded game source used by gameWorld()

authoringSource.coordinateSpace: Newly authored integer game-pixel offsets from the stage origin and rise above its soil line. Concept percentages are not copied as collision coordinates.
authoringSource.limits: Geometry prototype only. No authenticated Figma capture, new runtime artwork, authored spawn override or continuous-world connector. Existing runtime art and production levels-data.js are unchanged.

gardens.title: Frostarkivet
gardens.intent: Two stair-and-ladder routes flank the seed wheel. An upper service gallery connects both sides; the right landing prepares the departure toward the thaw shaft.
